findings.namedBuyers: Frédéric André is the strongest named organizer-side contact: EHC identifies him as Director of the Information Systems Department; he explicitly says he organized and moderated the 2026 symposium and announces the fourth edition for 14 January 2027. The official 2027 programme post names him, and EHC communications lead Caroline Boesch congratulates “Fred et ton équipe” beneath it. This supports a relevant 2027 organizer relationship; it does not prove hotel purchasing authority. Dr Mikael de Rham is a secondary executive referral contact: EHC Director General, named in the same official 2027 post, not a verified accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed fourth edition on 14 January 2027: reception 13:30, programme 14:00, networking aperitif 18:00. Final closing time is not published. The EHC announcement dated 19 October 2026 is a publication, not the event date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: retain only a conditional lodging or small ancillary-meeting conversation. The published event is a single afternoon in Morges, not Founex; no overnight demand or Founex–Morges transfer arrangement is established. Do not qualify a room block or propose replacing the confirmed main venue.
findings.venueCommitments: Le Cube, Avenue de Vertou 2C, 1110 Morges, Vaud, Switzerland, is publicly confirmed for the 2027 edition by EHC and its linked ticket page.
findings.accommodationSourcing: hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed. Neither the official announcement nor the linked ticket description identifies a hotel, accommodation booking route, room block or hotel buyer. Registration being open does not establish hotel sourcing being open.
findings.organizationStructure: EHC is a private nonprofit healthcare institution; it is the named event organizer on the ticket page. No external PCO or accommodation agency is identified in the reviewed edition-specific sources.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 main venue is already announced as Le Cube. No incumbent hotel or accommodation overflow is identified in the reviewed sources.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Frédéric André first, referencing the 14 January 2027 programme and his symposium organizing role. Ask who coordinates visiting-speaker/delegate accommodation, whether any overnight requirement exists, whether a hotel is already appointed, and whether Founex with transfers would be acceptable. Use Dr Mikael de Rham only as an executive referral route if needed. Do not quote a room block before these points are established.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Delegate registration is open, but hotel procurement accessibility remains unconfirmed. The named organizer relationship provides a route to ask about visiting speakers and out-of-area participants, not evidence of available hotel business.
